title: Draft: the Trump admin plans to use the UN General Assembly to push a global "freedom of expression" declaration that EU lawmakers call an attack on tech rules (Eliza Gkritsi/Politico)
summary: Eliza Gkritsi / Politico: Draft: the Trump admin plans to use the UN General Assembly to push a global “freedom of expression” declaration that EU lawmakers call an attack on tech rules — The White House and Republican party allies have repeatedly attacked EU rules that govern online platforms as censorship.
